lines.beaver_en: Welcome. How can I help you?
lines.en: I'd like a consultation about a loan.

lines.beaver_en: Sure, what do you need the loan for?
lines.learner: 집 계약금이 부족해서 대출을 받으려고 해요.
lines.en: I'm short on a house deposit, so I want to get a loan.
lines.roman: jip gyeyakgeumi bujokaeseo daechureul badeuryeogo haeyo.

lines.en: About ten million won. What's the interest?

lines.beaver: 일 년에 오 퍼센트예요. 수수료도 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: It's five percent a year. There's also a fee.
lines.beaver_roman: il lyeone o peosenteuyeyo. susuryodo isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 처음에 한 번 만 원을 내시면 돼요.
lines.beaver_en: You just pay ten thousand won once at the start.
lines.beaver_roman: cheoeume han beon manwoneul naesimyeon dwaeyo.
lines.en: I see. I want to pay it back little by little each month.

lines.learner: 수입이 이백만 원이라 형편이 넉넉하지 않아요.
lines.en: My income is two million won, so I'm not well off.
lines.roman: suibi ibaengman wonira hyeongpyeoni neongneokaji anayo.

lines.beaver_en: Then you'll need to save on living expenses.
lines.learner: 네, 공과금하고 보험 비용이 많이 들어요.
lines.en: Yes, utility bills and insurance cost a lot.
lines.roman: ne, gonggwageumhago boheom biyongi mani deureoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How much can you pay back each month?
lines.en: About 500,000 won. I'll save on living costs.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 가계부를 쓰면 도움이 많이 돼요.
lines.beaver_en: Good. Keeping a budget book helps a lot.
lines.beaver_roman: joayo. gagyebureul sseumyeon doumi mani dwaeyo.
lines.learner: 네, 써 볼게요. 이 달러 수표도 바꿀 수 있어요?
lines.en: Okay, I'll try. Can I also exchange this dollar check?
lines.roman: ne, sseo bolgeyo. i dalleo supyodo bakkul su isseoyo?

lines.beaver: 네, 바꿔 드릴게요. 서류를 작성해 주세요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, I'll exchange it. Please fill out the form.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, bakkwo deurilgeyo. seoryureul jakseonghae juseyo.
lines.en: Thank you. I'll save money and surely pay it back.
